title: vaporize test mode resolved bare swift through Swiftly 6.3.2 instead of Xcode-selected Swift 6.4
closeReason: The Xcode-selected Swift routing fix was verified and savepointed by commit a5bc417c, including the focused CUJ-01 regression.
createdBy: chatgpt loom harness after operator correction to test via vaporize

historicalContent.triggeredBy: While correcting savepoint verification to run through Vaporize, `vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh --package-path .../savepoint-commit.digikoma.clia test -- --disable-automatic-resolution` failed before tests because Vaporize executed `/Users/sonoma/.swiftly/bin/swift test`, whose installed Swift version was 6.3.2, against a Swift tools 6.4 package.
historicalContent.observedFailure:
$ /Users/sonoma/.swiftly/bin/swift test --package-path private/universal/domain/scm/digikoma/savepoint-commit.digikoma.clia -c release --disable-automatic-resolution
error: package 'savepoint-commit.digikoma.clia' is using Swift tools version 6.4.0 but the installed version is 6.3.2
historicalContent.expectedBehavior: Vaporize's SwiftPM build/test/package lanes should use the Xcode-selected Swift toolchain so substrate Swift 6.4 packages test through the canonical Vaporize gate.
historicalContent.fixSummary: Vaporize now routes `runSwift` and `runSwiftPackage` through `xcrun swift ...`; a CUJ-01 regression verifies that SwiftPM package commands are prefixed as Xcode-selected Swift arguments.
verification: Installed patched Vaporize binary at `/Users/sonoma/.swiftpm/bin/vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh`; previous binary backed up to `/Users/sonoma/.swiftpm/bin/vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh.bak-20260626T105502Z`.

Focused Vaporize regression passed through Vaporize: `/Users/sonoma/.swiftpm/bin/vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh --package-path private/universal/substrate/collectives/wrkstrm-core/private/apple/spm/vaporize@wrkstrm-core.cli --configuration debug test -- --disable-automatic-resolution --filter 'CUJ-01 routes SwiftPM package commands through Xcode-selected Swift'`.

Savepoint package canonical proof passed through Vaporize: `/Users/sonoma/.swiftpm/bin/vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh --package-path private/universal/domain/scm/digikoma/savepoint-commit.digikoma.clia test -- --disable-automatic-resolution`; Vaporize printed `$ /usr/bin/xcrun swift test ...` and the suite passed 15 tests in 2 suites.

modernizationAddendum20260626.triggeredBy: The operator clarified that the stack should be looking to use Swift 6.4, not merely whichever `xcrun swift` happens to resolve.
fixSummary: Vaporize now preflights SwiftPM package invocations by reading the package's `swift-tools-version` and comparing it with `xcrun swift --version` before running build/test/package lanes.
The package app build path in SwiftAppInstaller now runs package builds through `xcrun swift`.
The shared SwiftCLIInstaller dependency was updated in swift-universal so CLI install/uninstall lanes use `xcrun swift package ...`.
modernizationAddendum20260626.expectedBehavior: A Swift tools 6.4 package should either run through the Xcode-selected Swift 6.4 compiler or fail early with a clear Vaporize validation error that names the resolved compiler and required tools version.
verificationPlan: Run the new CUJ-01 Swift tools/compiler parser test through Vaporize.
Run the existing CUJ-01 Xcode-selected Swift command routing test through Vaporize.
Run savepoint package tests through Vaporize as the canonical proof lane.
Build and self-install Vaporize through Vaporize so the installed runtime carries the Swift 6.4 preflight.
verification: `/usr/bin/xcrun swift --version` reported Apple Swift version 6.4 from the Xcode-selected toolchain.

`/Users/sonoma/.swiftpm/bin/vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh --package-path private/universal/substrate/collectives/wrkstrm-core/private/apple/spm/vaporize@wrkstrm-core.cli --configuration debug test -- --disable-automatic-resolution --filter 'CUJ-01'` passed through Vaporize and printed `$ /usr/bin/xcrun swift test ...`.

`/Users/sonoma/.swiftpm/bin/vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh --package-path private/universal/substrate/collectives/kura-org/private/universal/domain/scm/digikoma/savepoint-commit.digikoma.clia test -- --disable-automatic-resolution` passed through Vaporize; 15 tests in 2 suites passed.

`/Users/sonoma/.swiftpm/bin/vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh --package-path private/universal/substrate/collectives/wrkstrm-core/private/apple/spm/vaporize@wrkstrm-core.cli --product vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh --configuration release build --skip-install` completed through Vaporize.
The freshly built Vaporize binary self-installed and printed `/usr/bin/xcrun swift package ... experimental-uninstall` and `/usr/bin/xcrun swift package ... experimental-install ...`.
Post-install smoke passed through the installed Vaporize binary: `--filter 'CUJ-01 parses Swift tools and compiler versions for 6.4 preflight'`.
